accepted_user_intent: Artisanal equipment should be occasional; study Diablo II before assigning rates.

proposed_direction.material_budget: Crafting materials belong to the weighted loot choices rather than a generous automatic extra packet.
proposed_direction.quantity: One material per successful material drop.
proposed_direction.bosses: More rewarding general loot without guaranteed crafting materials.
proposed_direction.input_base: A compatible modified item, with recipe-specific base requirements to be defined.
proposed_direction.limiting_ingredient: Require a Fragment instable catalyst for a crafted-equipment attempt; its availability is the main proposed constraint.
proposed_direction.random_result: A craft gives an artisanal item; its random properties can make the result less desirable than hoped.
proposed_direction.pacing: A few meaningful crafting opportunities over a normal playthrough; availability to be measured against actual encounters before setting percentages.

pending: Recipe identities, counts, costs and properties
Compatibility with the existing fragment-based improvement service
Rules for normal and modified equipment outside crafting
